(define (domain dizal)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types maga zude lubud fosap)
  (:predicates
    (burobez ?dika - maga ?baviz - zude)
    (dubugo ?dika - maga ?gamos - zude ?lakaved - zude)
    (kofuk ?dika - maga ?fopog - lubud)
    (fudov ?latip - lubud ?nami - lubud)
    (zedurep ?fopog - lubud)
    (dukul ?fopog - lubud)
    (sogef ?baviz - zude)
    (vinu ?kavetif - fosap ?baviz - zude)
    (keve ?baviz - zude)
    (deno ?baviz - zude)
    (zokosin ?baviz - zude)
    (foma ?dika - maga)
    (niraduv ?dika - maga)
    (zozum ?dika - maga)
    (nuvoda ?dika - maga ?baviz - zude)
    (vuril ?dika - maga ?baviz - zude)
    (femo ?baviz - zude)
    (tabi ?baviz - zude))

  (:action kibel
    :parameters (?dika - maga ?gamos - zude ?lakaved - zude ?latip - lubud ?nami - lubud)
    :precondition (and (burobez ?dika ?gamos) (dubugo ?dika ?gamos ?lakaved)
                       (kofuk ?dika ?latip) (fudov ?latip ?nami))
    :effect (and (burobez ?dika ?lakaved) (not (burobez ?dika ?gamos))
                 (kofuk ?dika ?nami) (not (kofuk ?dika ?latip))))

  (:action rifuraz
    :parameters (?dika - maga ?baviz - zude ?fopog - lubud ?pade - lubud ?kavetif - fosap)
    :precondition (and (burobez ?dika ?baviz) (sogef ?baviz) (vinu ?kavetif ?baviz) (kofuk ?dika ?fopog)
                       (zedurep ?fopog) (dukul ?pade))
    :effect (and (not (kofuk ?dika ?fopog)) (kofuk ?dika ?pade) (not (vinu ?kavetif ?baviz))))

  (:action sebo
    :parameters (?dika - maga ?baviz - zude ?latip - lubud ?nami - lubud)
    :precondition (and (burobez ?dika ?baviz) (deno ?baviz) (foma ?dika)
                       (zozum ?dika) (kofuk ?dika ?latip) (fudov ?latip ?nami))
    :effect (and (nuvoda ?dika ?baviz) (not (zozum ?dika))
                 (kofuk ?dika ?nami) (not (kofuk ?dika ?latip))))

  (:action rada
    :parameters (?dika - maga ?baviz - zude)
    :precondition (and (burobez ?dika ?baviz) (zokosin ?baviz) (niraduv ?dika))
    :effect (vuril ?dika ?baviz))

  (:action beded
    :parameters (?dika - maga ?kezo - zude ?baviz - zude)
    :precondition (and (nuvoda ?dika ?kezo) (burobez ?dika ?baviz) (keve ?baviz))
    :effect (and (femo ?kezo) (zozum ?dika)
                 (not (nuvoda ?dika ?kezo))))

  (:action vumomos
    :parameters (?dika - maga ?zimepu - zude ?baviz - zude)
    :precondition (and (vuril ?dika ?zimepu) (burobez ?dika ?baviz) (keve ?baviz))
    :effect (and (tabi ?zimepu) (not (vuril ?dika ?zimepu)))))

I need to reason through the domain carefully, since the names are relabeled.

Mapping: kibel = move (burobez = at location, dubugo = adjacency, kofuk = holds lubud/key). rifuraz = unlock-like via vinu (fosap). sebo = a "use" that sets nuvoda (carry-like), consuming zozum. beded = deliver: femo target, restores zozum. rada sets vuril (given niraduv, zokosin). vumomos sets tabi (requires vuril and keve at location).

Goal: femo tapalu, femo vapo, tabi vapak, tabi niru.

Start: tefer at duteme, kofuk ditit, zozum, niraduv, foma.

Step 1: Get to tapalu/vapo to be able to femo them. femo tapalu requires beded with nuvoda tapalu obtained via sebo at tapalu (needs deno tapalu, foma, zozum, kofuk at a lubud with fudov edge). Path to tapalu: duteme -> tapalu (dubugo tefer duteme tapalu).

Key chain: ditit -> zonod (fudov ditit zonod) -> silud -> dirade. Need kofuk ditit to move: sebo uses kofuk latip->nami, so ditit can be converted to zonod etc. Use kibel only moves location; sebo converts key and sets nuvoda.

Plan:
1. (kibel tefer duteme tapalu ditit zonod) — requires dubugo duteme->tapalu; kofuk changes ditit->zonod. Note kibel takes latip->nami, so this works.
2. (sebo tefer tapalu zonod silud) — deno tapalu, foma, zozum; sets nuvoda tefer tapalu, consumes zozum, kofuk -> silud.
3. (beded tefer tapalu tapalu) — nuvoda tapalu, burobez tefer tapalu, keve tapalu? keve is only petu. So instead use beded with keve petu: need to be at petu.

Re-plan: after step 2, move to petu: tapalu -> petu not adjacent directly; dubugo tapalu petu exists (yes: dubugo tefer tapalu petu). So:
3. (kibel tefer tapalu petu silud dirade)
4. (beded tefer tapalu petu) — femo tapalu, zozum restored.
5. (sebo tefer petu silud dirade)? needs deno petu, yes; kofuk silud, fudov silud dirade ✓. nuvoda tefer petu, consumes zozum.
6. (beded tefer petu petu) — femo petu (not needed, harmless) but we need femo vapo: need nuvoda vapo. Instead get vapo: from petu -> niru (dubugo petu niru), niru -> vapo.

Current key: dirade, no further fudov from dirade, so use another sebo on vapo chain. Alternatively do vapo first. Simplify: after step 4 we have zozum, kofuk dirade (zedurep but no fudov from dirade, dead end for sebo). Use rifuraz instead to not depend on keys? Keeping it concise, the key-consumption path is needed for vapo: 

Final plan route: at petu with kofuk dirade; sebo needs fudov edge from dirade, none. So prior to step 3 keep kofuk silud: reorder so sebo for vapo uses silud, and femo tapalu uses earlier sebo.
